scientific.integrity: The proof is self-contained at the level of Hausdorff covers. The focal source is used for the snowflaked p-Banach setup, the point-separation curve-rigidity theorem, and the L_p boundary example; the new connected-set dimension claim is proved independently.
limitations: The lower bound requires point separation by the continuous dual.
The theorem identifies the minimum Hausdorff dimension but does not classify all equality cases.
No corresponding packing- or Assouad-dimension classification is claimed.

title: Sharp continuum dimension in snowflaked p-Banach metrics
